描述_EN: when the resist is washed off, the design is revealed in white against a blue ground. resist-dyed textiles come from several different provinces of china, their patterns being produced by covering a portion of the cotton with a substance that resists the liquid colouring matter when the cloth is immersed in the dye bath. this piece shows one popular design of spots and swirls. blue and white cottons such as this originated in rural areas of china, away from the urban mainstream.
描述_ZN: 当抗蚀剂被洗掉时，图案就会在蓝色的底子上露出白色。 抗染纺织品来自中国的几个不同省份，它们的图案是通过用一种物质覆盖一部分棉花而产生的，这种物质在布匹浸入染浴时可以抵抗液体染色物质。 这幅作品展示了一种流行的斑点和漩涡的设计。 这样的蓝白棉布起源于中国的农村地区，远离城市的主流。
